items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 6:1
items.html: Bina is called the upper earth, and Malchut is called the lower earth. And in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, whereby the bottom Hey, which is Malchut, was included in the first Hey, which is Bina, Bina is called by the name the land of Edom. (Page 870, Sub Header, “to emanate”).
